entities.summary: Henri Carel Willem "Hans" Schnitger was a Dutch field hockey player who competed in the 1936 Summer Olympics. Schnitger was a member of the Dutch field hockey team, which won the bronze medal. He played all five matches as forward. He was born in Enschede, where he lived until his death.
